name: Heat & Mass Transfer
summary: Conduction, convection and radiation, from fins and transient cooling to heat exchangers, boiling and mass transfer.

topics.name: Modes of heat transfer and the energy balance
1D steady conduction: thermal-resistance networks, contact resistance, critical insulation
2D steady conduction: shape factors and finite-difference methods
Transient conduction: lumped capacitance, Biot and Fourier numbers, one-term solutions
Convection fundamentals: boundary layers and dimensionless groups (Nu, Re, Pr)
Forced convection in external flow: plates, cylinders and tube banks
Forced convection in internal flow: pipes and ducts
Heat exchangers: types, LMTD and effectiveness-NTU methods
Radiation: blackbody, emissivity and view factors
Mass transfer: Fick's law, diffusion and heat-mass transfer analogies
